keyEvents.text: Delay in match (Newcastle United).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match (Fulham).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Fulham 0, Newcastle United 0.
Delay in match because of an injury Sean Steur (Newcastle United).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Joe Willock replaces Yoane Wissa.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Lewis Miley replaces Nico González.
Substitution, Fulham. Rodrigo Muniz replaces Gonzalo García.
Substitution, Fulham. César Palacios replaces Josh King because of an injury.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Matias Fernandez-Pardo replaces Sean Steur.
Substitution, Fulham. Kenny Tete replaces Timothy Castagne.
Substitution, Fulham. Ryan Sessegnon replaces Oscar Bobb.
Goal! Fulham 0, Newcastle United 1. Jacob Murphy (Newcastle United) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner.
Goal! Fulham 1, Newcastle United 1. Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) right footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Fabian Schär replaces Malick Thiaw.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Anthony Elanga replaces William Osula.
Fabian Schär (Newcastle United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Amar Dedic (Newcastle United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
